## 5 CONCLUSIONS

This study showed the same performance for RLDA and MLP in problem of elbow angular  position classification; based on the SME amplitude envelope: Both methods achieved average classification accuracies above 80% for a number of classes until 4 but individually; 5 subjects achieved similar results in 5-class   setup; which means 200 shift between consecutive   classes. be a better   classification accuracy can be reached with another feature instead of amplitude envelope that was used.  However, this May probably will also change the comparative performance between the methods. Considering that for MLP there is effort to define the architecture and also learning  parameters; its use is only justified if there is need of generalization that cannot be achieved   by the RLDA that does not require the predefinition of parameters, it is practical and fast. great
